name: Seimyaku Clinic
description: Seimyaku Clinic — a block theme for a nephrology and blood-pressure clinic that follows people over years, not single visits. The home page opens on a full-bleed documentary photograph with a pale blue-grey wave veil that rises, a hairline arc and a scroll pill; the headline sits below the photograph with a row of four white cards at the foot. A medallion splits the single slashed top menu. The narrative continues under the same veil with a docked headline, three sticky chapter sheets that stack, a giant light word with ruled follow-up rows and photographs to the right edge, three people followed, the team as a slashed list, a fee table, the visit, dated notes and the clinic letter. Outfit for headings, Figtree for reading. Sample content in English, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, French and German. Quiet cool palette; WCAG AA colours; calm motion that respects reduced-motion.

fonts.role: display: headings, the giant section words, fees, the wordmark (variable 100-900, Latin subset)
